name: tModLoader
description: Modded Terraria server (tModLoader 1.4) from the project's GitHub releases. Put .tmod files in mods/ and list the enabled ones in mods/enabled.json. Allow 2 GB of disk and at least 2 GB of memory, more for large mod packs.
startup_done: Type 'help' for a list of commands

variables.name: tModLoader Version
variables.description: Release to install: 'latest' for the newest stable release or a tag such as v2025.08.3.1. Current releases run on the .NET 8 image, older 1.4 releases on .NET 6; the install log says which runtime a release needs. Reinstall the server to change it.

variables.name: World Name
variables.description: Name of the world and of its file in saves/Worlds. A world with this name is created if it does not exist yet.

variables.name: World Size
variables.description: Size of a newly created world: 1 small, 2 medium, 3 large.

variables.name: World Difficulty
variables.description: Difficulty of a newly created world: 0 classic, 1 expert, 2 master, 3 journey.

variables.name: World Seed
variables.description: Seed for a newly created world. Leave empty for a random one.

variables.name: Max Players
variables.description: Highest number of players that can be connected at once.

variables.name: Server Password
variables.description: Password players need to join. Leave empty for an open server.

variables.name: Message Of The Day
variables.description: Message shown to players when they join.

variables.name: Language
variables.description: Language of the server's own messages.
